reference_epoch_rule: first finite navigation row; read exactly one reference state
position_source: latest valid F9P at or before initial epoch, propagated with given initial velocity to epoch; subtract rotated antenna lever once
evaluation_alignment: one shared fixed translation from the predetermined initial reference position; no method-specific or trajectory fitting
common_outer_start: reference initial epoch; interpolate LIO at that epoch only after available scan endpoint, declare bounded delay
KF_GINS_initial_epoch: first IMU epoch at or after reference epoch; record offset; advance given initial position by initial velocity times offset
heldout_rule: same protocol, but export and performance remain prohibited until development evidence and freeze
GNSS_invalid_rule: reject nonfinite or nonpositive receiver standard deviations; retain reason and original row ID
imu_noise_source: fixed i2Nav-Robot-Baseline IC-GVINS gvins_i2nav.yaml 6c602f8d974fbe5be1183771541c90057e9e3bb6; transferred engineering priors, not fitted ADIS noise identification
scale_prior_note: 300ppm Gauss-Markov std is a declared project approximation for KF-GINS scale states, absent in upstream GVINS config; requires bounded sensitivity before strong-baseline status
reference_row_selection: single earliest original reference row at/after max(reference first timestamp, first IMU, first valid causal GNSS, first primary LIO cache timestamp); selection uses timestamps/input validity only, never position error
duplicate_reference_rule: nondecreasing times allowed, stable first original row per timestamp, no smoothing or alignment
